name: Blue & Brown | Multifunction Anti-Theft USB Charging Crossbody Shoulder Bag | Stylish, Secure, and Ready for Adventures
description:
The Multifunction Anti-Theft USB Charging Crossbody Shoulder Bag in Blue & Brown is the ultimate blend of style, security, and convenience. Made from high-density, waterproof fabric, it offers durability, comfort, and organization for work, school, travel, or outdoor adventures. Its breathable, decompression design ensures proper ventilation, heat dissipation, and shock absorption, reducing shoulder strain even under heavy loads.

Key Features
Anti-Theft Design – Lockable main compartment and hidden pocket keep your valuables safe; reflective accents provide added nighttime security.
Ample Storage – Spacious main compartment, multiple interior and exterior pockets, plus a card pocket on the shoulder strap for easy access.
USB Charging Port – Stay powered on the go with a built-in external USB port (power bank not included).
Comfortable & Ergonomic – Padded back and shoulder strap reduce stress and enhance support.
Versatile & Stylish – Unisex design for use as a messenger bag, chest bag, casual backpack, or travel bag.

Product Details
Material: High-density, waterproof fabric
Weight: Lightweight and portable
Compartments: Main zipper compartment, hidden anti-theft pocket, multiple small pockets
USB Port: External charging port for on-the-go device charging

Benefits
Protects valuables from theft and unauthorized access
Keeps essentials organized and easy to reach
Enables device charging while traveling or commuting
Reduces shoulder strain with ergonomic design
Water-resistant, durable fabric for long-lasting use

Suitable For
Students, professionals, and commuters
Travelers, hikers, and outdoor enthusiasts
Everyday casual, business, or adventure use

What’s in the Box
1 × Blue & Brown Multifunction Anti-Theft USB Charging Crossbody Shoulder Bag

Special Notes
Ensure the internal USB cable is connected to a power bank to enable charging functionality.
Avoid overloading to maintain comfort and durability.
Clean with a damp cloth; do not use harsh chemicals.
